pipeline: Hybrid Analysis (WarpWeftUNet Segmentation + Morphological Skeletonization + Calibrated Pitch Measurement)

conclusions.mechanistic_advantage: Eliminates reliance on strict mathematical harmonic ratios (unlike pure FFT) by explicitly segmenting yarn cores, while preserving absolute physical scale calibration ($S_x, S_y$ in px/cm).
conclusions.limitations: Inference latency is higher (~25-45ms on GPU, ~120ms on CPU) than pure deterministic FFT (~8-15ms), but provides high robustness to surface color variations.
